title: Penn State Extension — Protecting Your Roses through Pennsylvania Winters

common.applies_to: Hybrid Tea, Floribunda or Grandiflora rose; general care outside pruning
common.preserved_uncertainty: "12-inch-deep mound" after several killing freezes; "Water thoroughly late in the season, after the first frost, but before the ground freezes"; "Clean up all debris ... so that fungal spores do not overwinter"; fertilise monthly from April, stopping by August. For F10, the page describes a covering of leaves, boughs or bark over the mound; a collar or burlap wrap wasn't found in this check.
